changes_made.explanation: Removed CLIP (used for image encoding, not generation), added VLAW-MDM (the proposed model), and normalized output descriptions. CLIP is mentioned but only as a feature extractor, not as a generation model.
Normalized metric variants to base forms (BLEU-4 → BLEU, ROUGE-L → ROUGE) as per guidelines
No LLM-as-judge evaluation mentioned in the paper
The paper explicitly states it focuses on quantitative evaluation and does not conduct human evaluation

overall_notes: The paper focuses on multimodal dialogue generation with vision-language warm-up tasks. The extraction was mostly accurate, but needed minor corrections: CLIP was incorrectly included as a generation model when it's only used for image feature extraction. The paper explicitly mentions limitations in qualitative evaluation and focuses only on automatic metrics.
